Genelec 8351 page and manual pages read by a research pass 2026-11-12: one XLR female analog input, one XLR female AES/EBU input, one XLR male AES/EBU output (thru), two RJ45 GLM network ports (control data, not Ethernet audio: modelled as aoip like the 8341A and the template takes no audio route), a rear MAINS INPUT 100-240 V (the inlet type is not named: iec-c14 follows the 8341A precedent and is listed in the plan as assumedConnectors). The panel layout is not stated (positions guessed). Build params: the shipped 8341A recipe scaled by the width ratio 287 / 237 (a 126 mm coaxial dish at 317 mm); the woofer drivers are not read, so the baffle picture shows the coaxial dish only. 287 x 278 x 433 mm (datasheet, size ok). Generic artwork only (content/generic-panels/<id>.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): connectors, knobs and indicators drawn at the port positions, no photo, no logo, no lettering. Every port and control position is a guess (confidence guess): no drawing or photo was opened.
